title: Kissed-By-Fire Japanese Gelatin Bowl
description: Aromatic, umami-rich, aerated Japanese gelatin dessert featuring an unflavoured gelatin base, served in a piping hot tandoor clay pot.
instructions: Combine dashi broth, sake, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar in a saucepan and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
In a separate bowl, dissolve unflavoured gelatin sheets in 250ml of hot water, then set aside.
Once the dashi broth mixture has cooled slightly, whisk in the dissolved gelatin and pour into a tandoor clay pot or a heat-resistant bowl.
Chill the gelatin mixture in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, or until it has set and turned into a firm, jelly-like consistency.

Before serving, garnish the gelatin with yuzu zest, yuzu juice, and mozu seaweed, then place the bowl in the oven to warm the gelatin for 5-7 minutes, or until it has reached a warm, slightly caramelized colour.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let it cool for a minute or two before serving hot, in the clay pot or bowl.
